eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: San Juan, UT; at 2:57 PM on AUG 1, 2025 Effective until 2:57 PM AUG 2, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Old La Sal Evacuation Orders still in effect. Zone: 1-3 Ready.Zone: 4 Set status with only residents being allowed to enter. Zone: 5 ReadyZone 6: Remains the same Go status. But Residents of Mountain Shadows, Lower Highway 46 and Hang Dog will have access and will be allowed to stay. These three areas will be at Set status, the rest of Zone 6 (Peaceful Valley) will still be on Go.Zone: 7-8 ReadyPlease continue to follow all official instructions and updates.Thank you for your cooperation and patience as we work to keep everyone safe.
